dividend_yield_source: Assumption: 1.3% continuous - NIFTY's trailing dividend yield has sat in a 1.1-1.4% band; index futures imply a similar carry. Sensitivity to q is second-order for every case here and is not hidden: q appears in every pricer signature.

historical_vol_yfinance_NSEI.source: yfinance ^NSEI daily closes, 4 Nov 2024 - 3 Nov 2026 (last row of the feed, 2026-11-04, is NaN and excluded); log-return stdev annualised x sqrt(252)

iv_term_structure_from_same_file.note: far LEAPS prints are illiquid settlement prices - indicative only

modelling_vol_choice: One flat vol, sigma = 15.34% (the real ATM print), is used for ALL cases so that MC, PDE and closed forms are compared on identical inputs. The 3-year autocall is additionally stressed at sigma + 5 pts (Case B), which spans the full term-structure / historical range above.
rate_source: Assumption: 6.5% continuously compounded, the house convention of the sibling greeks-lab / var-risk-engine repos (NSE chain tools use DEFAULT_RATE = 6.5%); close to the Indian 10y G-Sec yield in early Nov 2026.
sigma_source: ATM implied vol of the 3 Nov 2026 NIFTY chain, nearest expiry 9 Nov 2026 (6 days), ATM strike 23,800: CE IV 10.76% / PE IV 19.92%, averaged = 15.34%. The CE/PE gap is a settlement-print parity break measured by the sibling greeks-lab repo (parity-implied forward 23,690 vs spot 23,811); the average is the unbiased single-number summary and matches the realised-vol cross-checks below.
spot_source: UndrlygPric on NIFTY index-option (FinInstrmTp='IDO') rows of the NSE F&O bhavcopy for 3 Nov 2026, file BhavCopy_NSE_FO_0_0_0_20261103_F_0000.csv in the 220-file archive (fo_YYYYMMDD.zip, Mar-Nov 2026)
